HL500 Leisure Deep Cycle 12 V 130 Ah

definition.text: Nominal RMS voltage of the inverter's AC output. Same concept as the DTDL element 'acOutputVoltageV' in models/dtdl.
Direction the module faces, as a compass bearing clockwise from north: 180 = due south. Same concept as the DTDL element 'azimuthDeg' in models/dtdl.
How the parallel connections are made: cable-hop, busbar or diagonal. Same concept as the DTDL element 'cabling' in models/dtdl.
Number of PV cells connected in series along one string.
Electrochemistry of the battery cells, e.g. LEAD_ACID_FLOODED. Same concept as the DTDL element 'chemistry' in models/dtdl.
What the battery was built for: deep-cycle (thick plates) or SLI starter (thin plates). Same concept as the DTDL element 'construction' in models/dtdl.
Module current at the maximum power point, at STC.
Position of the battery along the post-to-post cabling, counted from the bus take-off. Same concept as the DTDL element 'hopPosition' in models/dtdl.
Year and month in which the battery was installed in this bank. Same concept as the DTDL element 'installedOn' in models/dtdl.
Maximum battery-side charge current of the controller. Same concept as the DTDL element 'maxChargeCurrentA' in models/dtdl.
Absolute maximum PV open-circuit voltage the charge controller tolerates. Same concept as the DTDL element 'maxPvVoltageV' in models/dtdl.
Rated capacity at the 20-hour discharge rate (C20). Same concept as the DTDL element 'nominalCapacityAh' in models/dtdl.
Nominal voltage of the DC system or battery. Same concept as the DTDL element 'nominalVoltageV' in models/dtdl.
Module voltage with no load connected, at STC.
Rated DC output power at Standard Test Conditions (1000 W/m², 25 °C cell, AM1.5). Same concept as the DTDL element 'wpPeak' in models/dtdl.
Continuous AC output power the inverter is rated for. Same concept as the DTDL element 'ratedPowerW' in models/dtdl.
Module current with the terminals shorted, at STC.
Current at which the measurement shunt produces its rated voltage drop. Same concept as the DTDL element 'shuntRatingA' in models/dtdl.
Angle between the module plane and horizontal: 0 = flat, 90 = vertical. Same concept as the DTDL element 'tiltDeg' in models/dtdl.
How the batteries of the bank are connected: parallel or series. Same concept as the DTDL element 'topology' in models/dtdl.
Module voltage at the maximum power point, at STC.
